title: Microsoft SharePoint: attackers can run their own code
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 88 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched.

category.label: Documents and collaboration
category.why: It holds shared documents and internal pages.
category.doThis: Patch it, or ask your provider whether they have.

summary: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Sep 28, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.

evidence.title: 2 public GitHub repositories claim a proof of concept for CVE-2026-65660
CISA Vulnrichment marks CVE-2026-65660 as actively exploited
